note: Adaptive music stems (src/audio/adaptiveStems.ts). Four seamless loops, ?stems adds 'Adaptive stems' to the Music picker. Not part of public/music/manifest.json (that list is the guitar tracks and the Playlist).
key: A minor pentatonic (A C D E G)
loop: 32 bars = 85.333 s = exactly 3,763,200 frames at 44.1 kHz; loop point on a bar line, tails wrapped circularly so the seam is continuous
format: Ogg Vorbis, quality 4 (about 128 kb/s), 44.1 kHz stereo
loudness: about -20 LUFS integrated each (same as the guitar tracks), true peak -5.9 to -7.3 dBTP, lows mono under 120 Hz
source: Original synthesis from Matthew's sample-lab skill chains (github.com/Bannon-github/skill-library, sample-lab/), rendered 2026-10-23 by Grok Bot. No samples, presets or third-party audio. No ElevenLabs.
licence: Original work generated for this project; Matthew owns it.

stems.note: dark, sparse dyads A/E, D/A, C/G, G/D every 8 bars; 4.2 kHz low-pass
warm open chord pad, a chord every 4 bars; 7.5 kHz roll-off
slow swell, low-passed at 2.6 kHz so it sounds muted
gate on a 6 Hz grid, pattern 1-1-1-0 (about 4.5 pulses/s), gate floor -12 dB, 3.3 kHz low-pass; a layer under the other stems
